verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data export feature, no open-format exports, and no account-closure or portability process for Increase. The List Events API, OpenAPI spec and CLI are developer building blocks for reading individual records programmatically. They are not a documented capability to export all of a user's data and leave, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
